name: Canvas
about: Your Canvas courses, assignments and to-dos, from your school's Canvas.

settings.name: baseUrl
settings.label: Canvas address
settings.obtain: The address your school's Canvas opens at, without anything after the host.

settings.name: accessToken
settings.label: Access token
settings.obtain: In Canvas: Account, Settings, Approved integrations, New access token. Give it a purpose and no expiry (or note the date). Some schools turn this off; use a cookie service then.

settings.name: cookieUrl
settings.label: Cookie service
settings.obtain: Instead of an access token: the /cookie address of a canvas-cookie service you run, which keeps a signed-in Canvas session and hands its Cookie header to the app.

settings.name: cookieToken
settings.label: Cookie service token
settings.obtain: The cookie service's API token. Needed with the cookie service, not with an access token.

settings.name: timezone
settings.label: Time zone
settings.obtain: An IANA time zone name. Leave it empty to use the phone's.

limits: Give either an access token or a cookie service and its token, not both.
With an access token, quizzes and pages that Canvas only serves to a browser session may not open.

delta.about: The command center's Canvas relay (/canvas/..., /canvas-upload/...) signs in with its own cookie service.
